meta.note: The Ordnung condition's recorded outputs replayed with the checked-out code, once as it ships (all_on) and once per ablation, each switching one function off for the length of the replay (scripts/eval_ablate_checks.py). Counts are of the scored items (a required to-do with a due date); 'flagged' is a date the person is told to check (low confidence or 'Please check'). 'changed' lists every scored item whose date, outcome, flag or confidence differs from all_on. Not every split is out of sample for every check: the two-dates check was written after two holdout letters were read late, so on holdout it acts on the letters that motivated it, while holdout2 and holdout3 were written after it; the reading check and the re-ask were written after a holdout2 letter's empty reading (ADR 0015, 0016), so only holdout3 was written after them; the test and dev splits were seen while the checks were made. No model was called.

no_two_dates_check.label: Two-dates check off
switches_off: ordnung.ingest.plan.settle (the two-dates check and the letter's-own-notice guard)

no_reading_check.label: Reading check off
switches_off: verify_extraction(check_reading=False) (the reading check, the dropped-date check and the notice beside)

no_reask_no_reading_check.label: Re-ask and reading check off
switches_off: verify_extraction(check_reading=False) (the reading check, the dropped-date check and the notice beside)

all_off.label: All code checks off
switches_off: ordnung.ingest.plan.settle (the two-dates check and the letter's-own-notice guard)
verify_extraction(check_reading=False) (the reading check, the dropped-date check and the notice beside)
